I get the feeling many of you may think I’m pretty secure and for the most part I would agree with that (if not let me know what insecurities you see in me that I may be unaware of :D), but that being said I can always do more to knock them out. I identify a tweet I saw a couple days ago and see how many of these apply to me and where Some of these I think I’m quite good at and perhaps might even say I’m the epitome of the opposite of (“Actively fear looking awkward”, “Overthink texts and emails”, “Obsess over not making others uncomfortable”). Many of these I don’t think I do but I also don’t really epitomize the opposite of (“fight often”, “dislike people for no clear reason”) and so on. I think my biggest insecurity is probably the first one “Replay conversations, scanning for mistakes”. I have done this in the past so I may need to be more mindful of it in the future. One exercise that the guy who tweeted the above recommends is whenever you have an insecurity is to “feel your feelings” and try to understand why. A lot of insecurities come from locally optimal strategies. An example he cites is that social anxiety comes from minimizing the risk of being disliked. If you don’t engage and talk with others (especially new people) you don’t risk saying something off putting. At the same time because so much time is spent protecting from being disliked you aren’t putting yourself out there and being liked. He puts in this helpful disagram I want to start feeling my feelings and understanding what my insecurities are trying to protect me from as they come up more! I also spend a good chunk of the walk thinking about the latest One Piece chapters and my theories for what will happen going forward. We’ve been eating well lately in the One Piece world. After the walk I head home and pretty immediately go to bed. Saturday The day begins with the usual trash pickup. I see “The Philosopher” as well as “The Politician” and “The Writer”. Sadly “The Notetaker” is out of town so I actually have to do the unthinkable and lead trash pickup today. At this rate people will no longer believe me when I say its my first time doing this. I wear my Mooni sweater and I’m pleasantly surprised that “The Politician" and “The writer” are interested in buying them. Maybe I can really start to spread this idea. I think it would be really cool to see people rep “Mooni” :D. After the pickup I head over to North Beach to co host a scavenger hunt with “The Professor”!. For some context a couple years ago I came up with the idea to host an event that essentially combines a scavenger hunt with a game of assassins. The idea being that a bunch of teams have riddles to solve that point them to locations in a fixed area while a separate team of assassins tracks down all the playing teams and tries to kill them. The teams that solve riddles have to avoid dying and figure out who the assassins are. Kind of like a game of among us. It was pretty fun and over the years its underwent a bunch of modifications. “The Professor” came aboard after the first one and now after subsequent games we settled on a new set of rules that we think streamline the process. Now every team is both a player and an assassin. Rather than having a fixed assassin team that goes after every team its more like the game assassin where every team has a specific target they try to assassinate and if they succeed they inherit the target of the team they killed. Also you get points for solving riddles and killing so even if you die you aren’t really out of the game. On top of that you can spend points to buy the location of your target. In order to solve the riddles you have to actually go to the location in question. For example if the riddle told you to go to Manny’s you couldn’t just say the answer you have to send a picture with your entire team there. If you’re the sort of person who is really into reading rules here is the full list In case any of you are curious cookies and want to try solving the riddles for yourselves here they are Find a place where everything is repeated back to you If Rapunzel was in SF this is where she would be I once found some Solomon’s seal root in Chinatown. Can you? In a different world this is where Adam threw dollar bills at Eve How much boba is here? Which bar would I go to to lose weight Hmm? The trail of tears meets the Bahmas? I’m a bit lost. I hear this place is really buzzing Come on really? There’s one of these areas in New York too I’d go to bat for this place (Answer: Joe Dimaggio park) Go here to see into a Russian's soul Joam's place Go here to eat some fish on the dance floor This place has its ups and downs Go buy some hugs and kisses This museum really takes you places Mayor Lurie lives in this square Go see a mummy In case you tried solving them, gave up, or just want the answers here they are Find a place where everything is repeated back to you (Answer: Telegraph hill. There are parrots there) If Rapunzel was in SF this is where she would be (Coit Tower) I once found some Solomon’s seal root in Chinatown. Can you? (A few shops in Chinatown should have this :D) In a different world this is where Adam threw dollar bills at Eve (Answer: Garden of Eden strip club. I’ll admit I love this joke too much to not include here) How much boba is here? (Answer: Plentea boba shop) Which bar would I go to to lose weight (Answer: Li Po. Sounds like liposuction) Hmm? The trail of tears meets the Bahmas? I’m a bit lost. (Answer: Lost Coast Outfitters. This is the intersection of Columbus street and Jackson street. Columbus landed on the Bahamas and Andrew Jackson led the trail of tears) I hear this place is really buzzing (Answer: The Hive SF) Come on really? There’s one of these areas in New York too (Answer: Washington Square Park) I’d go to bat for this place (Answer: Joe Dimaggio park) Go here to see into a Russian's soul (Answer: Red Window) Joam's place (Answer: Mama’ s) Go here to eat some fish on the dance floor (Answer: DJ sushi) This place has its ups and downs (Answer: Yo Yo's) Go buy some hugs and kisses (Answer:  XOX truffles) This museum really takes you places (Answer: cable car museum) Mayor Lurie lives in this square (Answer: Levi's plaza) Go see a mummy (Answer: Transamerica pyramid) It was really fun running this a 3rd time and I think all the players had fun too! Congrats to “The Quant,” “The Writer,” and “The Mushroom hunter” for winning! And big thanks to “The Professor” for handling a lot of the logistics I was too lazy to handle. We made everyone pay $5 to put towards a pot for the winners. Originally when doing this we were gonna just pay the winners in cash but I was pleasantly surprised when we / the winners decided they wanted Mooni jackets instead so I’m gonna be giving them some at a discounted price. After the scavenger hunt we went back to the Humza cave to play some Secret Hitler. We had some good games as my strategy of claiming to be a “liberal Hitler” went about as well as one would expect and my strategy of trying to play the game normally failed because thats not the way I usually do things and people got suspicious. Darjn theres no winning for me 😅. From there I go to Thriller Social Club to meet up with “The Fisherman,” “The Hombre,” “Mr. Greenflag,” and one of their college friends. This does overlap with game night so I leave everyone from above in my apartment to play more games while I head out. I highly doubt they’d steal anything, I don’t want to kill the party, and I thought it would be kinda funny to have a game night at my apartment with me not there. On my Uber ride to Thriller Social I meet someone from Eritrea. I’ve never met someone from there before so thats pretty cool. Along the way he’s telling me his life story. He served in the military on an international basis and then left the country. I watched a video on Eritrea once and I was pleasantly surprised that his experience was not what the video made it out to be. While its true that the military does a lot of central planning he didn’t seem to be quite so brutally oppressed. With that being said though I did ask him if he would ever go back to Eritrea and he did say no for what its worth. I also decide to send it and sign up for the Ultramarathon for next year. I should probably start training at some point :D . It was great catching up with everyone at Thriller. For those unaware its a barcade so we wind up playing arcade games while hanging out and talking about AI, geo politics and a whole bunch of other stuff. Sadly I’m an old man so I get tired and head out around 11:30. While this was happening I asked how the game night was going at my place and apparently they were also pretty tired and called it around 9. I’m glad they kept hanging though I do think its inherently funny and I love to keep the vibes going. Sunday Today begins with the usual trash pickup. I hang out largely with “The Fisherman,” “Mr. Greenflag,” “Always causing a racquet” and a few other folks. The pickup itself goes about the same as usual. After the pickup though I met someone pretty interesting who did competitive jump rope. Apparently she can jump rope on her butt. Wow! Apparently she also collects post cards. She does this thing called Postcrossing where if you send a postcard to some random person you’ll get a random post card back. We’re gonna do our own version of that where I send her a Mooni sticker and she sends me a postcard. I’m looking forward to it! I also meet someone who when I ask her the question “Whats something cool or interesting about you that people wouldn’t expect?” she pauses and basically says “Nothing I’m pretty boring.” She has a dog with her though and when I ask how long she has had the dog she says forever. Is the dog a family dog? Did her parents have it before? These are questions I never get the answer to. I try an easier question and ask her “Whats something you like to do for fun?” And I basically get the same answer. I’ll admit this is the first time I’ve been so stonewalled by the question. I’m kinda impressed honestly. After trash pickup I walk around outside and enjoy the nice day. After such cloudy weather its hard to express just how happy I am to have such a nice day. It really really warms up my soul. I can spend a long time just walking around enjoying a nice day like today. I briefly run into “Mr. Socksessful” and catch up with him. Today I learned there is a movie called naked gun. I didn’t think guns wore clothes but maybe a holster counts? I don’t know I’m just a mamby pamby Californian and all that. Eventually I go to Golden Gate Park to hang out with “The Professor,” “The Taco,” and “The Pickeballer.” It's not terribly eventful but since “The Professor” is leaving soon I’m glad we can do a park hang on such a nice day. From there I go home, ship some Mooni jackets and stickers, and write this newsletter.

content: Previous newsletters If you want to see any of the previous newsletters look here Shoutouts Shoutout to “The Philosopher” for starting a new job. He said that one condition for shouting him out in this is that I mention how wealthy and famous he is. He is indeed very wealthy and famous. The Bruce Wayne of our generation. Shoutout to “The Shadow Brigade” for finishing her 2 week sharp shooter training. Maybe I should hire her as part of my dating team since she knows how to shoot her shot. Shoutout to everyone that ran in the SF marathon today. Whether it was the 5k, 10k, half, or full y’all did amazing! Too many folks to shout out individually but if you’re reading this and you ran today great job!! Monday Today begins with another day in the Python mines. The big project I’m working on looks like it might finally be wrapping up. Its been a hard fought battle with many ups and downs, but fingers crossed we may finally have something we’re happy with. After work I go to the gym with “The Professor” and “The Quant”. Now that I’ve improved my fashion to a degree the next step in making me less ugly is going to the gym. To be honest this was MUCH harder than I thought it would be for a variety of reasons. One of the first things was that a lot of the time spent at the gym was focusing on form. I tried squats, plancks, dumbbell curls. The biggest thing those have in common is that my form sucks for all of them. A lot of it was small but admittedly important things like keeping my back straight, my feet shoulder with apart and other such things. I didn’t really get to lift at my maximum potential and worse I didn’t get to use what I think is one of my stronger muscles. My sheer will. I was able to take on the Humza trail. I was able to do something else we will cover later in the newsletter. And yet I wasn’t able to do more than 10 squats. This was mainly because my form started deteriorating and I was told to stop but even still it felt frustrating to me. Interestingly I don’t often feel frustrated when trying to learn or do something new. Generally I have no fear of embarrassing myself in public (something many of you should be well familiar with). I think its because I feel like (absence of form), I should be lifting or doing more than I was. And the fact that I wasn’t sore the next day probably means I was right at least as far as pushing my actual physical limits. But even still it did feel bad nonetheless. This is a case where my pride definitely got the better of me. And as much as I hate to admit it I think I’m exactly the sort of person who is susceptible to ego lifting. Rationally the correct way of thinking here is to realize this is the start of my journey and it doesn’t really matter. So long as I take things one step, squat, or other repetition at a time and focus on form thats what really matters. Sadly the monkey in my brain strongly disagrees. Big thanks to “The Professor” and “The Quant” for very patiently teaching me all these things. “The professor” brought up an excellent suggestion that I hire a personal trainer to help me learn form. I think I’ll start looking into that. Tuesday Today is just an ordinary day in the python mines. Progress is made towards my project chipping away at it and cracks of light start to emerge. Wednesday V0 of the project looks like its basically done. There are some last items here but we have a version we feel ready to start using. After work I head to Midnight Runners. The run itself was pretty normal. I met a guy who lives in Napa and comes all the way to SF just for this run club. Thats some dedication right there. Once I have sufficiently shuffled my feet I catch up with some of my friends. Sergeant Sassy’s date from last week went well! Hooray! I also meet a guy who owns his own nightclub. Way back in episode 15 I went to a night club as part of a Midnight Runners party and it turns out its the same club! That was pretty cool! I also got to put my shuffleboard skills to the test. There was a beer company offering shuffleboard with the person who scored the highest getting a free trip to Belgium. The score to beat was 9. I put my best foot back, best hand forward and mustered all my skills to score … 4. Sadly it seems all my effort was 4 naught. Ah well it was still fun! Thursday Before work I go the Almost Friday run club. More specifically I go to the post run hang over at Flywheel. I could have done the run but I’ve crashed the post run hang a few times without running and I’m starting to get known as the guy who does that. I can’t besmirch such a hallowed reputation by doing something like running. I talk with a number of people and inevitably the topic of the marathon comes up. They’re quite surprised when I tell them I plan on rawdogging it. I’m pretty sure they’re more stressed about it than I am :D. One of the folks mentions that she's nervous for the half and another person tells her “Think of this as the celebration of all the training that you’ve done. Theres no reason to be nervous”. A great line! She then turns to me and says “I don’t know what that means for you though.” If i finish this I can’t wait to go back there and tell them! Today while I was at work I came across an interesting tweet that got me thinking about the question “what are you trying to avoid feeling by doing what you do” I quite liked the honesty in the answer in the tweet above and thought I’d give it a thought about myself. One obvious one for me is that I hate feeling bored so I constantly seek out different activities and trying different things. If I find myself on a weekend with nothing to do I’ll try to either find some activity or rally around friends to do something. Overall I think its been a net positive for me because I love trying new things and avoiding the feeling of boredom has been a good motivator for me to continually try to push my comfort zone. That being said though I do sometimes wish I was better at being bored. One thing I want to try but am a bit scared to is purposefully declining social plans and just sitting in my apartment and not really doing anything just to build muscle. Its not fun but maybe it might be good for me. On a related note I can be bad with FOMO. If theres an event happening without me or I need to leave early I always wonder what I might miss out on. Maybe theres some really cool story, maybe I miss the chance to learn something really interesting about one of my friends. Perhaps even some after event where the people there get to bond closely about something. To that end I have a very hard time leaving things early. There are times especially late at night where I do kinda want to go home and sleep or chill but I’m worried something really cool will happen. This isn’t rational but it is a feeling of mine. Finally for a more minor one I really hate making others wait for me so I really hate being late. Occasionally when I’m running late or close to, I flash back to the 5th grade when my teacher told me that if you're late it means you're disrespecting someone's time. Thanks Mrs. Shern, glad you’re still with me 20+ years later 😅. After work I head over for bar night with the lads. I saw “The Philosopher,” “That's nuts,” “The Mosher,” “The Juggler,” as per usual, but what I didn’t expect was seeing “Granola Girlie” and “The Writer”. It was cool to see all these people in one place. I also learned that the bartender at the bar we usually go to is a fellow One Piece fan! Sadly he's not up to date on the manga but its still sick to learn. As the night goes on I find myself getting really tired around 10pm or so. This is one case where I probably should have gone home and slept but I did have some FOMO and wanted to stay. By the time 11 rolled around I had had enough and decided to just sleep regardless. It was still a super fun time though! Friday The last necessary pieces I need to do for the project are done. There is still room for improvement but we’re at a state where its good enough and we have bigger fish to fry. My project is ultimately a small part in a bigger project we need to get soon so the battle still very much rages on. Nevertheless I appreciate this victory and will savor it to the best of my abilities. I also happened to find another interesting tweet at work that got me thinking. I realize that I am very much a # 2. While I’m not someone who necessarily has grand dreams of changing the world I think I am someone who tries to be pretty impactful in my local community and the part I don’t always spell out is because I want to be someone who matters to the people that I care about not just because I want to help the people I care about (of course that is relevant too). Theres no real followup to this I just thought it was an interesting tweet. After work I host a board game night with “Always causing a racquet,” “The boxer,” “The Plower,” “The Juggler,” and “The pasta prince”. We play secret Hitler. Nothing particularly unusual here but someone did drop the great line “I’m excited to be Hitler in the most socially acceptable context”. Saturday I make a brief trip to the slums known as the Marina to pick up my bib for the half marathon. I see a whole bunch of people crowded around some race expo thing a ma jig and worry this will be the line for bib pickup and I’ll need to miss trash pickup. Such worries are quickly assuaged when I find that bib pickup only takes about 5 minutes. From there I head to trash pickup. We have a pretty solid turnout today with 27 people and between “The Philosopher,” “The Politician," “The Grandma” and more its quite the party. After trash pickup I head home to deep clean my apartment. Actually scratch that a more accurate version is I head home to supervise people I pay to deep clean my apartment. It had been a while since my apartment had gotten one and given my utter laziness at this stuff I decide to utilize my software engineer powers and throw money at problems I don’t want to solve myself. While this is happening I play online Dune with “The Quant,” “The Professor,” and “The Taco”. Once my apartment gets the TLC it so desperately needs I wander around for a while before going to “The Writer’s” housewarming party. At this party I heavily put my improv skills to the test. When someone asks what I do for fun I mention trash pickup and when they ask how I got into it I mention that my parole officer got me into it. This leads to them asking how I wound up in prison and I say that 5 years ago I did something which combines the best parts of arson with the worst parts of insider trading and follow up by insisting that whoever is listening is a smart cookie that can figure it out. When they inevitably can’t I tell them that 5 years ago I was really into investing and thought for sure Apple would do poorly so I decided to short it. When they didn’t I wanted to make my short calls a reality by trying to burn down the Cupertino office. I had staked it out and done my research however things went wrong when the security guard who usually covers a previous shift showed up at a time when there wasn’t supposed to be any personnel. The reason he showed up was because he was having marriage problems at home and wanted time away from what he described as “The old nail and coffin”. While in prison I supposedly learned to make prison wine and got really good at not dropping the soap.  I dropped various hints like how I was supposed to be released after 500 days but due to good behavior I got out after 420. Most people naturally didn’t believe me but their reactions were great. One group tried to look me up and couldn’t find my case. Another definitely didn’t believe me but I think they were impressed with my ability to come up with stuff on the spot and kept asking me follow up questions which was really fun. I felt a bit bad for the third group where one person actually did believe me and said “woah I never met someone who went to prison before”. When it was explained she was genuinely surprised and thought I actually went to prison! I guess there a lesson in there somewhere but like many math textbooks I’ll leave it as an exercsise for the reader. Sadly I do actually need to leave the party early (around 11:30) because I have to get up at 5 for the half marathon. It sucked because I was feeling wide awake and was having a really good time! I also got this picture of me that might be Hinge worthy. Sunday I wake up at 5AM to head out for the half. On the way down I take the N-Owl which I was expecting to be pretty sketchy but sure enough it was full of runners and more lively than a bus at 5AM had any right to be. I get to the Ferry building and am greeted by a flurry of folks I spend half an hour milling around before getting into position. The way this works is everyone is in a different corral and the start times are a bit staggered. Originally my goal is to finish within 3 hours so I go in the last corral. Once the event officially starts it feels like forever until my corral can actually go. Eventually the moment of truth comes and I set off. I’ll break this down into a few parts. The first 5 minutes Whenever I start running I always need some time to warm up. Subsequently the first part of any run tends to feel sluggish. Initially I run without any music which lasts for all of 5 minutes before I realize I need the music to focus. It truly is incredible just how well music can help with that. The first 8 miles Whenever I do something like this I tend to play only a few songs on repeat and switch whenever I get tired of them. To kick things off I play one of my favorite feel good songs “Staying Alive”. As its playing I clear the first 4 or so miles. Once I get past the initial slowness things start going alright. I’m able to maintain a consistent 9:38 pace or so for the first many miles. If the half marathon is a video game we reach our first miniboss once we get through Fisherman’s Wharf and get to the hill near Fort Mason. This hill isn’t actually too bad and I manage to run up it without too much difficulty. After clearing the hill I decide to switch to my second song that I’ll put on repeat, the Aqua Teen Hunger Force first opening song. From Fort Mason things go pretty smoothly for a while. There is a bit of uphill when we get to the bridge but its manageable. From there we get to The Golden Gate Bridge and our beloved Karl the Fog. Around here I switch the song to “Moves like Jagger”. Miles 8 to 11 After crossing the bridge I’m starting to feel it. My knees and legs hurting. My morale starts taking a bit of a dip. Of course I’ve made it this far and its not like I’m gonna quit but I definitely feel myself slowing down. To help myself out I imagine different friends cheering me on in my head, or in the case of “The Philosopher” saying this will turn out like the bean challenge if I don’t finish. I switch things up to “Not Like Us” for the next little while. Once we cross the bridge we go down close to Sausalito near some of the forts. This part wasn’t too bad but a lurch started developing within me. Since we were going downhill that meant we needed to go back up hill. Every step down was another step up. Every pant for air going down was 3 pants for air going back up. We see the bridge above us and a hill which brings us to THE FREAKIN HILL This is the true boss of the half marathon. I won’t mince my words here. THIS PART SUCKED. I HATED IT. I had to muster everything I had to keep myself in the fight here. It was truly an ordeal. Eventually though I made it through. Make no mistake though I did bear hill will towards this boss. Finishing up Now it was time to cross the bridge and go back into SF This is my first time crossing the bridge on this side since the time I accidentally did it back in 2022 leading to a bridge security guard to think I was suicidal, but thats a story for another time. With the hill finished I was in high spirits and switched back to “Staying Alive” to really give myself the boost I needed. I’m starting to feel myself pick up and I start singing aloud a little as I go across the bridge. Once I cross the bridge I find that there is a last bit of uphill. This is certainly not boss level not even mini boss level but it feels worse than it is because I was expecting this to end once I crossed the bridge. Interestingly the last bit of the race can feel like one of the most arduous because mentally I feel like I’ve already finished but I haven’t physically. Originally I wanted the first One Piece opening “We are” to be the last song I had for this half but I fat fingered it and went with Aqua Teen Hugner Force again and was too lazy to change it. With the finish line in sight its finally time I cross the finish line and end it! Not the best time in the world but considering I didn’t really train for it I consider this a win! As the quote from above goes “Think of this as the celebration of all the training that you’ve done. Theres no reason to be nervous”. Perhaps in my case the quote should be amended to “Think of this as the celebration of you being willing to commit to the bit no matter how crazy. Theres no reason to be nervous.” I can’t wait to go back to the Almost Friday run club and see the look on their faces when I tell them I finished :D Soon after crossing the finish line I run into “The Dentist” who did the same half as me. I wind up finishing around 9. Originally my goal was to finish around 9:30 so I could make it to trash pickup at 10. While my finish time was considerably ahead of what I thought it would be the time it takes to leave the half marathon finish line is also considerably longer than I thought it would be. The roads are blocked, the Ubers are $40, and the only other way out is shuttles which takes forever. We were legitamiltey waiting for 30+ minutes to get on a shuttle from The Presidio to The Ferry Building. To all the trashers reading this, sorry I did try to make it but I couldn’t :( :( . After getting back to The Ferry Building I go to Rise and Set to get brunch with “The Dentist”, “The Enabler”, “Tight Knit”, “La Tacqueria royalty”, and some of our other run friends. It was quite fun debriefing on the half marathon, complaining about the hill and just vibing. Since I completed the half marathon I’m cheating on my diet today and got a Wagyu burger which was delicious!! While talking I learned there are these things called gels that people apparently eat which contain protein. Also in case y’all didn’t know apparently there are small water bottles you can carry around in a belt bag in case you need water. There are a whole bunch of crazy optimizations one can make to make the process easier 🤯. Once we wrap up brunch we go and get some donuts over at Bob’s donuts. I’m not cheating on my diet *that* much so its more of an I watch folks eat. Sadly on the way there I do wind up making an enemy of a stranger. We were outside the brunch place and since there was a big group of us someone tries to go through us and says “excuse me”. I was feeling playful and decided to respond “Your application for an excusal has been granted and approved”. I meant this in a joking way but the guy did not appreciate it as he shot me a look and said “you must be real funny”. One of my friends “La Tacqueria Royalty” defended me by saying “hes the funniest guy I know”. Thanks man, you’re a real one! Some other folks did concede that what I said could come off as obnoxious, and while they wouldn’t say anything they could see why he would be annoyed. Personally I still think it was funny but it is what it is I guess. Perhaps I should be more careful around strangers. Once I have my fill of watching people eat donuts I go to the Mission to hang out with “The Professor,” “The Pickleballer,” and “The Taco”. After hanging out in Dolo and getting Mexican food I go home to write the newsletter.

content: Previous newsletters If you want to see any of the previous newsletters look here Shoutouts Shoutout to “The fisherman” for starting a newsletter of her own. This is awesome and I never thought I’d actually inspire someone else to do something like this. The first issue came out and it was great! Really appreciated the thoughtfulness, vulnerability, and your funny comments! Can’t wait for the next issue Shoutout to “The Raven Keeper” for getting a new job! Congrats and I hope this new job is a lot of fun! Shoutout to “The Bar tender”. Happy birthday! You’re grilling skills definitely meat expectations And finally shoutout to “The Enabler”. Happy birthday again! Already wished ya so will keep it brief but wanted to let the wider newsletter community know too :D. Personality quizzes Last week “The Shadow brigade” sent me some personality quizzes. I’m gonna put them here along with my results in case anyone else wants to take them Muni Personality quiz Quiz is here https://sftransit.fun/ My results Vegetable quiz Quiz is here Absurd Trolley quiz Quiz is here Monday To end the cliffhanger from last week I sent the message to the girl I asked out and as a wiseman once said “When there is no response, there is a response.”  Ah well is what it is. Today is a pretty normal day. After work I just go home and chill out. I flirt with the idea of going to chess club but opt against it. Instead I decide to start coming up with clues for a scavenger hunt I’m planning with “The Professor”. Everyone reading this is invited! Link is here hope to see ya’ll there! Tuesday Nothing particularly crazy today. Just an ordinary day at the coding factory. Wednesday Today after work I go to Midnight Runners. For the first time in a while I didn’t have friends I was planning to meet so I wind up catching up with an acquaintance and some of his friends. I certainly didn’t expect that when I met up with this group I would be drafted into one of his friends “dating council”s. Essentially one of the friends (who we’ll call Sergeant Sassy) likes a guy and wanted to ask him out on a date. She went out with him to trivia at a bar for what she thought was a date but unfortunately that wasn’t communicated well and now she wants to explicitly say that she wants to have a date. We all brainstorm ideas and muster all 4 of our brain cells for how she can go about this and ultimately the simple but effective approach of saying “Hey I like you and I want to go out on a date are you interested?” wins out. Together we send the message and wait. The moments leading up to the message have a distinct rise in tension which drops down briefly as we celebrate the initial success in sending the message. For a brief moment we all catch our breath as the message has been sent. Briefly we distract ourselves with other matters before immediately seeing these This induces a feeling that internet scholars call “Three dot anxiety” in all of us. Unlike my attempt to ask someone out it looks like here we’ll immediately get to see the fruit of our labors. And … he said yes! He also wants to go out on a date with Sergeant Sassy.  I’m really happy that one attempt to ask out on a date went well this week! For a while longer the council continues to help the sergeant plan logistics and figure out the rest of when the date will happen and so on. Since the original attempt at a date was at a trivia night I suggested she send a text along the lines “I guess that first attempt was a trivial pursuit :D”. While it wasn’t sent it did get a laugh out of the group so we’re calling that a win. Oh yeah and in case you were curious the reason I called this person Seargant Sassy was because I asked her my standard question “whats something cool or interesting that people wouldn’t expect” and the answer she gave is that shes sassy so I guess thats what we’re going with here. Addendum 9/11: Turns out I misremembered this, it wasn’t her who said she was sassy, one of her friends said that. I apologize for spreading such blatant misinformation throughout the interwebs. Thursday Today after another day slinging python originally I was gonna go to a dating event with “The Raja of Rhythm" but I wind up cancelling and playing online Dune with some friends tonight. While I would have liked to go to the dating event it was really important that I play with my friends tonight and I think we all know the dating event would have ended with me getting rejected by everyone anyway. Don’t worry there will be plenty more opportunities for me to be rejected! The game of Dune itself goes pretty much the way I wanted. While I lost the battle I did win the war so to speak. Also I made great progress in what we might call “Blitz Dune” where I limit my moves to 20 seconds while my opponents take on the order of minutes. Friday Today after work I go with “The Plower,” “The Quant,” “The Professor,” “The Pickeballer,” and “The Plowers,” boyfriend to a restaurant called Prime BBQ down in San Mateo. As the name implies its a BBQ place with a wide variety of grilled meats and veggies. This is one of the few places “The Plower” will eat at (a list that includes roughly 4 places) and the meat there winds up being quite good! The beef tongue in particular is amazing and the tendon and lamb are quite tasty as well. The one annoying thing is the place proved to be on the spicier side which my poor sensitive tongue cried about. Afterwards we go to Na Ya desert cafe over in Hayes Valley. I wanted to do my usual here and get nothing but they have a minimum amount per person so I make it a point to tell the waiter I am getting the cheapest thing I can to meet the minimum and refuse to have any of it. Its important I stand up for my principles here. They can make me spend $$ but they can’t make me eat their food 😤. Sadly I get an unfortunate surprise when I get home and two packages that were supposed to be delivered weren’t there. These were both jackets I was very excited for. One of them was this ramen MUNI hoodie and the other was a custom Mooni hoodie that I ordered. I’m trying to get in contact with the sellers and see if they can resend them. Worst case I may have to re order because I really do want both of these 😢 Saturday The day begins with trash pickup as per usual. After another battle with the streets I do some errands and mostly just chill until evening. I did happen to learn that there was an SF standard article about two guys who walked 100k steps in a single day. As someone who did the exact same thing I wonder what did these hooligans have to do to get an article about them. I mean sure they posted on reddit and all but still! You know they slept before they did it unlike me so really they did it on easy mode When evening comes I head over to “The Enabler’s” birthday party! One of his friends has an apartment with a super nice rooftop that we reserved for a while. I decide to get him a birthday card like this Astute readers may remember a few episodes ago when I did the Amazing Race and me and my team had to pick edamame with chopsticks and put them in a container. Throughout the evening I try to get different folks to sign the card until I have a full card of signatures. And as a bit of a side bit I try to hide this from him by keeping the card awkwardly behind my back and giving it to his girlfriend to give to him. I wanted it to be a bit of a mystery as to who actually created the card. While the card went great the mystery part fell a bit flat. I guess I need to actually go to chess club so I can be the chessmaster I dream of being. I also try to think of what a good birthday present would be for him but sadly I can’t come up with anything that meets my bar for a good birthday present. For context I very much dislike giving thinks like gift cards. My ideal present is something that either only he would like, something only I would give him, something that is a call back to a specific moment in our friendship, or some combination of the above. Sadly nothing comes to mind that fits this description. By chance I happen to come across a $5 coupon at Buffalo Exchange and while its not the best I do know he likes thrift shopping so I figure its better than nothing and give it with the birthday card. While at the party there a bunch of mini stories that I thought were fun or at the very least meet the mildly amusing bar to be put on the newsletter. Mildly amusing story 1 I meet someone who works in social services over at UCSF. I ask her that since a lot of people WFH if she ever WFTs (Works from Tenderloin). This gets a mild laugh. Mildly amusing story 2 The apartment that we’re at happens to have a set of giant Jenga. A bunch of people are playing and the game manages to last for something like 10-12 minutes which is pretty impressive. The game winds up ending around 9:13. Personally I wish it had ended two minutes earlier as 9:11 would have been a great time to bring down the Jenga tower. I almost debated muscling my way into the game to ensure it but opted against it. I also want to start playing more Jenga so I can start using the joke “I feel like I’d be very good at Jenga. As a Muslim I can definitely bring down a tower” Mildly amusing story 3 I meet someone and the first thing she asks is “Whats a fun fact about you?”. This made me really happy as its the first person I met to ask the same sort of question back to me! I asked her why she asked and she said I seemed like a fun fact kinda guy. I tell her about my time walking the Humza trail. Really the story here is more in the fact that she asked the question. I asked her what her answer was and she mentioned that she came to the US when she was married. Interestingly despite asking the question she didn’t have a prepared answer unlike me. Maybe I should start answering more off the cuff Mildly amusing story 4 When talking with the girl from the story above and her husband I learn they are helping to throw a big block party in the Mission and since they’re public transit nerds they’re interested in “Mooni” stickers (essentially sticker forms of the Mooni hoodie that I made). They got a grant from an organization called franciscosan which gives money for things that add whimsey to SF. I very much want to make stickers and give them to this party because I applied for a franciscosan grant a while back to fund snacks and drinks for a walk around the perimeter of SF and they had the gall to not respond to me so now I want to find another way to take some of their money for my own fun ideas and it looks like this is it  😤 Well thats the end of the mildly amusing stories I hoped you enjoyed those as much as I did. With that lets get back to the party. After a bunch of mingling, socializing, and drinking (for other people) a cake is cut and the time on the rooftop ends. The party continues over at some clubs but I opt to go home. I don’t really like clubs as much because I prefer going to places where I can talk with folks. Instead I go clubbing over at the Humza cave where we have no music and some sheets to sleep on. Sunday The day again begins with trash pickup. Right next to Trash pickup there is a wedding brunch for some couple. After the trash is picked up I briefly crash the wedding brunch to see how the food they have compares to our trash pikcup brunch (spoiler alert our brunch is better). At one point I briefly consider going up to the bride and groom and congratulating them on the wedding on behalf of the trash pickup community and taking a selfie on the polaroid they have in the room. I find the thought gives me a bit of anxiety which sucks because I hate feeling anxious about this sort of stuff. Ideally I’d have the confidence to just do it. I do decide to get a 2nd opinion on the situation and ask some of my friends. I cleverly decide to mask it in a hypothetical by saying this is “about a friend” rather than me which will no doubt throw them off the scent that its really me asking about this … well until they read this newsletter anyway. Ah well thats a problem for when that happens. The consensus I get is I shouldn’t go up to them and let them have their day. Perhaps my anxiety in this case was good as it protected me from doing something I shouldn’t have but I still hate that I felt anxious. My ideal version of myself would have the confidence to act on anything I thought was interesting (regardless of whether I do it or not). Unfortunately I can’t stick around too long at the post trash pickup hang as I have a birthday to go to. Its “The bartender’s” (belated) birthday party. We go over to his house in Piedmont where he grills a whole bunch of meat for us which is delicious. Sadly I have less fun stories from this birthday party but its still a great time. Afterwards I go to meetup with a friend for dinner where I find the only Mexican place where I had to wait 50 minutes to get tacos. This was a crime against nature. The food itself was good, dare I say above average, but the wait was unforgivable. From there I go home and write up the newsletter.

excerpt: I made a character list detailing every character here. I got some feedback it can be hard to keep track. Let me know if this helps! Previous newsletters If you want to see any of the previous newsletters look here Shoutouts Shoutout to “The Philosopher” for…
content: I made a character list detailing every character here. I got some feedback it can be hard to keep track. Let me know if this helps! Previous newsletters If you want to see any of the previous newsletters look here Shoutouts Shoutout to “The Philosopher” for being about to start a new job and coming back to the U.S!! A second shoutout to my coworker “The Fantasy Football champion”. I really appreciate your help working on the deid project! Having someone else to work along side has been great. And I really appreciate your eye for detail, something I could certainly learn from! Monday Work is quite intense this week as I need to ship something that is a big blocker for a big project we are working on. I’m more focused than usual at work this week. I try my best to become one with the code and lock in. This extends past normal working hours as I work late into the night to ship stuff. While intense its also kinda fun. I wouldn’t want to work this intensely all the time but there is something satisfying to it in its own right. Tuesday Same as Monday. Progress is being made but there is more to do. Slowly but surely getting closer. Fingers crossed. Wednesday Today work progresses the same as it does the previous days. In the middle of the work day I get  texts from a couple of people congratulating me on my 200th trash pickup! This is a bit surprising to me as one of them is someone who moved out of the Bay last year and the other is someone I know but not super well (ie wouldn’t get this newsletter) and doesn’t keep up well enough to know that it happened. I learn from one of them that Manny (the Civic Joy Fund leader) sent out a weekly email with this in it This definitely made my day! Also fun fact, I’ve done trash pickup both before heading out to the airport and right after landing at SFO :D. Hopefully in a couple weeks I’ll have another story like that I can add to the list. Stay tuned to the newsletter two weeks from now to find the answer! I take a break from work and get dinner with “The Enabler”, “The Dentist”, and “The future Ironman”. We go to Bangkok Thai Street food. Its great to catch up with everyone. Naturally I don’t eat anything but I do have enough fodder for a Yelp review. After a long work week this was exactly what I needed to relax a little bit. One interesting tidbit I learn is that the reason the triathlon is swimming -> biking -> running is that the sports are done from most to least dangerous to make sure people do the more dangerous stuff when they have more energy. After dinner I go home and keep working for a few more hours. Thursday Today work eases up a bit and we go out to dinner to celebrate a new team member joining this week. We go to a tapas place called Canela Bistro Bar. This place was rather annoying as they wouldn’t let me eat my MIXT salad while I was there. When they first told me I put my salad on the floor and thought ‘ok fine whatever’. Things quickly go from bad to worse when another waiter comes by and tells me I can’t have food on the floor so they take it and say they’ll give it back once I leave. I think this is the first time in history I ever had a salad get coat checked! Begrudgingly I agree to this. Naturally I don't’ have any of the actual tapas there. I wasn’t going to to begin with and its not like I can support a restaurant with such totalitarian food practices. For shame! After dinner I go to bar night with the lads. For the first time in forever I get to see “The Philosopher”! Back from his travels in Canada and Europe and ready to once again become a contributing member of society. I get regaled with tales of Europe and how some folks can pay their way through it by being a findom. Maybe in another life where I was hotter I could do that but for now I’m stuck using that tech money to pay for the trip. While at the bar I chat with “The Quant”. I mentioned that last week I took the Ennegram personality test and get type 7. Normally I don’t think too much about personality tests as I think that while fun they aren’t really that accurate. But I do think I have a pretty strong overlap with the type 7 description. He agrees with me and mentions that I tend to do too many things and might be better served by focusing on a few things. He also suggests that I spend my Friday night chilling at home and thinking about what I should be doing rather than impulsively doing a bunch of things. Thats good advice, as to whether I take it stay tuned. After bar night I go home and work for a couple more hours before going to bed. Friday Today work progresses at an OK pace. Its not quite as intense as I feel myself closing in to a degree but I’m not out of the woods yet. Fingers crossed. After work I … go on a walk with “The Philosopher”. Sorry “The Quant”, I don’t wind up taking your advice after all. Perhaps another time. We wind up walking from his place in SOMA to Ocean Beach. If its any consolation the walk with “The Philosopher” does, as it often does, provide some interesting opportunities for reflection. One thing he mentions is that he doesn’t think I’m exactly neuro typical. I’ll admit that I may be a bit quirky but I’m not so sure I’d go quite so far as to call myself neuro divergent. He mentions that compared to some of our other mutual friends I don’t fit the description “well adjusted”. I also learn that apparently at a party we were at at a bar “The hombre” asked multiple women if they would date me and they all said no. I like to think thats because I still had the unicorn hat back then which may have been an immediate flag. Since I’ve been progressing through my fashion arc perhaps I wouldn’t get shot down quite so immediately now :D. He issues me a challenge that I should try to show up to his Thanksgiving with a date. We shall see if this ends up happening. Check back around episode 50 (which will also be close to the one year anniversary) to find out! I also find out that he, “Granola girlie,” “The Juggler,” and “The Mosher” amongst others are gonna be going on a camping trip over at The Lost Trail. This quite intrigues me as I think going camping like that would make for some great newsletter content and would be an interesting new experience. He doesn’t quite think that I can handle such a long camping trip, having to dig with a shovel to use a restroom, and eating camping food for many days. This in turn triggers my pride which now makes me want to go just to prove that I can do it. After coming back from the walk I come up with an idea for a new custom hoodie and stickers. I’m super excited for this design and can’t wait to wear the new hoodie. I also really want to make stickers with it and give them out to people I think it will add some whimsie to SF :D. Saturday The day begins with trash pickup as per usual. We have quite the turnout today. Many regulars like “The Politician,” “The notetaker,” and “The grandma” along with many new faces as well. I bring my airpurifier to trash pickup for reasons that I’ll explain later. When I’m inevitably asked about it I try a new strategy where I respond “Do you want the short answer or the long answer?”. I figured most people would say the short answer but I find its about a 50:50 split. As for why …well we’ll get to that. After trash pickup I wind up going to an alumni picnic over in Dolo for my old company. Its great to catch up with folks and see what people are up to both at the company and outside. Once again I’m asked about the airpurifier I would have loved to stay longer but I have a BBQ hosted by “Granola Girlie”. A couple days before the BBQ she sends this text blast And that ladies and germs is why I carried the air purifier the whole day. I’m reasonably certain that part was targeted towards me as I’m the only person she has seen carry one. When I ask her she sloppily tries to gaslight me Despite her best efforts I’m still convinced its targeted. The BBQ itself is great! I see “The pasta prince”, “The philosopher”, and an old friend from trash pickup I haven’t seen in a while. I also meet many new friends as well. One of the folks there studies meteorology and its cool learning how we can track what kind of sunlight is absorbed by comparing what comes from the sun vs whats reflected into the atmosphere. After the BBQ I go back to Haight Ashbury to meetup with “The shadow brigade”! This is the one weekend a month shes in town so I gotta strike while the iron is available. Our hangout mainly consists of us getting dinner and walking around. She has many moments that I find too funny not to put in the newsletter. Here are some samples For dinner she orders some eggplant and cauliflower. I pay for dinner and when she Venmos she says she was tempted to just say eggplant as the Venmo message but didn’t when she thought it could be misconstrued. She should have done it anyway as its funny and my Venmo is private When she finds out I read manga and watch anime she loudly says “FUCK YOU”RE A WEEB! BUT YOU HID IT SO WELL!”. This really gets me laughing. Building off my conversation with “The Philosopher” yesterday I ask her whether she thinks I’m normal and one thing she says is “If you weren’t so confident and outgoing you’d probably be bullied for being a nerd. But your confidence and outgoingness more than makes up for it so people like you”.  This also gets me laughing. Best for last here. She mentions that if she saw me back when I still had my unicorn hat she would likely think I was a quirk chungus. Once I look up what that is I laughed quite a bit. Its always a treat to hang out with “The Shadow Brigade”. We also talk about a bunch of deep life stuff that I won’t be putting in the newsletter but I greatly enjoyed talking about with you :). Sunday The day beings with me doing a couple hours of work before leaving the house to finish up some lingering stuff. I then go over to the Panhandle to witness the start of a Midnight Runners event. I would have gone myself if trash pickup wasn’t calling my name. I do see “The Dentist” and “La Tacqueria royalty” and wish them luck as they head off on their 9 mile run going up Twin Peaks. I mentally send them good luck while I comfortably take the bus. Trash pickup today is great as per usual. We’ve got some of the usual suspects with “The Raja of Rhythm,” “Always causing a Racquet,” “The notetaker,” and others. After trash pickup I meet up for a quick lunch with “The Professor” and “The Taco”. I hadn’t seen “The Taco” in a bit so it was great to catch up with her. From there “The Professor” and I go to a tea party that one of our other friends is hosting. While we’re waiting for the host to let us in I catch up with “The gamemaster” and some other friends I hadn’t seen in quite a while. Unfortunately I can’t stick around at the tea party because that was just a way to kill time until my real plan which was to meet up with my family. Since I didn’t know when they were coming I decided to go to the tea party for a bit but since the host was still setting up by the time my parents were in the city I don’t get to have any of the tea. Some of my friends were surprised at how abruptly I left. Heres roughly how it went down when the bus came Catching up with the family was great. We go to Anatolian table where my 30% off comes in clutch. We also go to a great burger place called Hamburger project over in Divisadero. The food here is actually good and I eat which of course means no Yelp review pending. After hanging out with my family I go to Dolores park. Part of the reason I come here is because I thought “The Raja of Rhthym” might be there since he sometimes goes there before evening Yoga. While I don’t find him I find something quite interesting. It turns out there is a singles event happening. I notice because there is a sign advertising and like a moth to a flame I go over to see what its about. It turns out however that when I get there the event is just wrapping up. It turns out someone I play Spikeball with is friends with one of the organizers of the event. From what I could tell the event starts with a game where people put name tags on their back corresponding to different historical figures and people had to figure out who they are. Someone was apparently Kim Kardashian, someone was Julius Caesar, and someone was Monica Lewinsky so we have a whole range of notoriety and accomplishments here. The event itself may be over but some of the folks go to Panchitas afterwards and I figure I may as well because the people there seem cool and could be new friends. While at Panchitas I talk with this one girl who really catches my attention. She is big into community organizing and hosts a cookbook club where she and some other folks cook recipes from a cookbook once a month. On top of that she apparently went to an accelerator to help folks build community building organizations. As someone who loves community this is a huge green flag to me. She mentions that she likes walking, hiking, and runs. On top of that she gives off great vibes and is single. I know I have to strike here. Alright if you all will permit to be honest (oh wait I’m the dictator of the newsletter so its not like I need permission or anything), I am pretty bad at asking girls out when its not via a dating app. But I gotta do this so I do. As she is leaving I get her instagram and resolve to message her later. I send her a message and don’t check my IG until the rest of the newsletter is finished. Well that point is now so lets see what happened And .. no response. Well it was pretty quick I suppose. I was hoping there would be an update for this newsletter but I don’t see the point in delaying so … tune in next week?

title: Episode 30
excerpt: I made a character list detailing every character here. I got some feedback it can be hard to keep track. Let me know if this helps! Previous newsletters If you want to see any of the previous newsletters look here Monday Today is mainly work. After last week…
content: I made a character list detailing every character here. I got some feedback it can be hard to keep track. Let me know if this helps! Previous newsletters If you want to see any of the previous newsletters look here Monday Today is mainly work. After last week we restructured the project and moved things around to account for the fact that we weren’t gonna meet the original deadlines. We still want to get stuff out so will be doing my best of course but now I won’t have the last thought when I go to sleep and the first one when I wake up be this project. I was debating going to chess club but opted not to because of something else I’m planning (stay tuned to find out what that is). Tuesday Same as Monday, no real change here except for the fact that I’m another day closer to the great sleep. Wednesday Today after work I *finally* go to Midnight Runners after the first time in what feels like centuries. Today at this run I’m joined by “The Quant” as is often the case but today I see 2 rare Pokemon show up being “The Enabler” and “The Dentist” and one less rare Pokemon “La Tacqueria Royalty” (in other words “The Enabler” squad). Its great to see them all but this run presents an extra challenge as they all run faster than I usually do. I manage to mostly keep up with them somehow but while they are casually strolling through the run I have to put in reasonable effort to keep up with those speed demons. Between the miles we stop and do bootcamp activities like burpees, squats, and so on. To make sure everyone else is doing the activities properly I take on a supervisor role and oversee  people rather than do the activities myself. I employ such motiativational tools as telling people I’m docking their pay if I ever see them slacking. After the run we hang out at Underdogs where I see “The Pasta Prince” working. When we’re taking the MUNI back I ask “The Enabler” how his friends would describe him in 3 words. Astute readers may notice the callback to a few weeks ago where my Dad asked me the same question. I got a couple responses from my friends which included (“Eccentric”, “Thoughtful”, “Committed”) and (“Contrarian (in a good way)”, “Relentless”, “Inquisitive”). Sadly I only asked this question when we had one MUNI stop left and there wasn’t enough time to answer. I did tell him I’d ask him again when we next see each other which looks like next week so I look forward to getting an answer then. Thursday Work is unusually quiet today. I suspect because many people took the day off or are working remotely its unusually quiet and I get into the zone much more than usual. After an above average day of productivity I go to Downtown First Thursday. When I get there the first thing I do is watch people do a hot dog contest where they have to eat a hotdog while wearing a blindfold and not using their hands. Its truly a sight to behold. My first impression is that these people were pre selected to go which is corroborated by the fact that the host references one of them as a previous champion. I find to my surprise though that after the first round they are doing another one for volunteers. As soon as the host says that my hand shoots up. Do I think I’ll win? Of course not. Does it sound like fun to try, heck yeah! I get up on stage and partake in the festivities. Manny the main organizer of both Downtown First Thursdays and Trash Pickup is in the audience so he records a video of me which he shares to a group chat. Unfortunately its hard to share videos in a newsletter so heres a screenshot I took when I uploaded the video to insta. To clear up a common misconception this isn’t who can eat the most hotdogs, this is who can eat a single hot dog the fastest. I do terribly as expected only being able to eat half the weiner in the time it takes for 1st place to finish but it was still quite fun. Apparently if you are able to eat weiner really fast you get a special invite to The Castro but thats at a level far above me. After this I meet up with “The Raja of Rhythm”, one of his friends from his Motorcycle class, and someone they just met at the fair. The person they just met is only gonna be in the Bay Area for a short time (a month). Between her and “The Shadow Brigade” thats two separate people I spontaneously met at an event run by The Civic Joy Fund that grew up in the Bay, moved away, and are only gonna be here for a few weeks. Seriously, what are the odds? I was waiting for this girl to say she is also in the army reserves or plays the harp or something to add another layer to the coincidences but sadly that didn’t come. (I later realized I actually saw this girl on Hinge like a year and a half ago or so, small world am I right?) Admittedly nothing at Downtown First Thursdays can top the wiener fest above but its still a great time. We check out an Orchestra playing jazz which is great (and also makes me think of “The Shadow Brigade”). We then go to a bar / music venue that has a bunch of skateboards on the wall as a form of art. After admiring these I note to myself that the situation calls for a bit of a change of pace and as if on queue we see “The Dentist”, “La Tacqueria Royalty”, and a couple of “The Dentist”’s friends. We all go and check out some of the live music happening outside skateboard bar which is more party vibes than the orchestra music we saw earlier. Unfortunately there is a party dynamic known as “Humza’s law” which states that a group of sufficiently large size that doesn’t all know each other at a party is gonna break away into smaller groups. This happened and as a result I spent a good while ping ponging between “The Raja of Rhythm group” and “The Enabler” group. The former mainly hung out at the Orchestra and the latter at one of the live music stages. Apparently the live stage had a DJ called “Washed out” playing that “The Dentist” is a big fan of. After a while “The Raja of Rhythm group” all wound up going home which was bad news for “The Enabler” group because now they were stuck with me for the rest of the night. We hung around the live stage for a while before checking out some of the live dancing they had. They had a DJ playing throwbacks like “Soulja boy” and “I know you want me” while we all danced to them. Once this ended the festival was basically over. I met a college student repping an Attack on Titan jacket who I recommended various things in SF to and some guy who looked like he had too much to drink lamenting the fact that he didn’t invest in NVIDIA back in 2022. While I’m no “The Quant” I tried my best to give the guy some investment advice regarding thinking about what he believes is likely to go up over a long time horizon and ignore short term market fluctuations. I was about a quarter of the way through my spiel when “The Dentist” and some of her friends said it was time to go. She said me and “La Tacuqeria royalty” were being too friendly talking to random strangers like this which may be true but you know there is a reason southern hospitality isn’t called Bay Area hospitality and I kinda wanna change that :D . As we are leaving the festival we run into some of “La Tacqueria royalty”’s friends who want to go to some bars. I’m the only one from our group who joins them while everyone else heads home. Hmm I should probably come up with a name for the people I’m with right? Well I don’t know them well enough to give em a nickname so lets call them Aditya, Maggie, Angelo, and Will because those are their real names. We all go to a tiki bar called Zombievillage where everyone except me and Maggie gets drinks. I learn here that Maggie apparently knows some of my trash friends from the Saturday trash pickup so I try getting her to come. She even says she may come this  Saturday. Stay tuned to find out if she does. After a while I get tired and decide to make a last minute hot date with my bed. Friday I start the day off with a nice long walk through GGP and down to Embarcadero and eventually over to “The Professor”’s place over in Mission Bay to play board games with “The pickeballer”, “The Quant”, “The Plower”, and some of our other friends. We play One Night werewolf where me and “The Quant” manage to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat in a truly stunning Werewolf victory. It was truly a work of art that I can’t properly convey in a newsletter like this. I even tried warning everyone by proudly proclaiming I was a Werewolf but our genius was far too much for a mere warning like that to get in the way of our victory. I think we played some other games as well here but after that Werewolf victory thats all a footnote. Most other people head off to a BBQ place in San Mateo and I would have loved to go with them but I have something far grander to go to, “The notetaker”’s 4th of July party! This party is a DEI flag party where we all have to wear an outfit inspired by a flag that isn’t just red, white, and blue (in other words no USA, Britain, France, etc.) I decide to go with a flag that doesn’t have red, white, or blue and Jamaica is one of the only flags like that :D. As part of this we were supposed to come with some fun facts about the country in question so here are some for Jamacia Ian Fleming the author of the James Bond series wrote them all in Jamacia Jamacia was the first caribbean country to have a website launching http://jamaicatravel.com in 1994. 1/3rd of the people in Jamaica live in Kingston. Originally I wanted to go with Djibouti so I could wear a shirt like this But I couldn't get the shirt delivered on time. As an extra challenge I decided to speak in a Jamaican accent for the entire party. To help you understand what thats like I’ll write out the rest of the party in a similar tone to how I spoke. Mon that was a really fun party mon. I got greeted by so many of the old friends mon I got to see “The Raja of Rhythm”, “The Yogi”, “Granola Girlie”, “The Pasta Prince”, and of course “The notetaker” mon. Speaking this way mon, it was really fun for an hour or two mon. The challenges mon they came up after that mon. My tongue was sputtering mon. It was really tiring mon. As I got to the 5.5 hour mark mon, my mouth was crying out for the mercy mon. We went up to the roof to see fireworks mon. The cold mon she lunged upon us mon. To fight the cold we all huddled penguin style mon. Apparently the party went to 3am mon. I would have loved to stay mon. I was tired mon. And I couldn’t keep up the accent mon. I went to bed at  1 mon but I feel like an old mon by comparison mon. Man even just writing that out was tiring! Saturday The day begins with trash pickup as per usual. We have a low of about 13 people which is below what we usually get these days. Its likely because people are either hung over, out of town, or both. For all of you who were waiting on the edge of your seats to find out if Maggie came to trash pickup … she didn’t. We’ll get her next time though! After trash pickup I go to prep for a board game night at my place and walk through GGP. Board game night starts and … surprise! Its not a board game night! Its a surprise party for “The Professor”! Ever since I knew that “The Professor” got the job I’ve been planning for the last several weeks to throw him a surprise party and tonight was finally the night! I employed his younger sister “The Pickeballer” to stall him until we were all ready, I got everyone in my apartment, and when he opened the door to come in we all yelled “Congrats Professor!”. I decorated my apartment for it as well. This was the first surprise party I ever threw for someone and in his words he said he was surprised and liked the gesture so we are calling it a success! We played Secret Hitler in which “The Professor” pulled off a miraculous gamble that won us the first round for the fascists. In the second round where I was also a fascist I apparently had really bad acting which lost us the game. Overall a big win but a little bit of a big sad. I came up with an idea for the party that everyone dress in a labcoat and a beanie to mimic his style which works great … for everyone who remembered to do it. Sadly I am not in the group that remembered to do it but since I organized the party I’m gonna honorarily say that I did it. So good job me! Today I also learn that the professor is leaving the Bay on August 18. The iminence of the deadline really hits me as he is one of my closest friends here. This now means I need to accelerate some plans. The two of us were already planning to organize a scavenger hunt together but now we need to do that ASAP. Also I have another event I want to organize. This will be one of the biggest things I’ve ever tried to pull off and I really want him to be here for this so I gotta make haste and move, make the event ,advertise, and get all my ducks in a row for it to be ready to go. Lets do it! Sunday The day begins with me going to a pilates class in the Marina with a pumpkin spice latte in hand! Nah I’m just messing with ya, it begins with trash pickup. Today is a momentous occasion as I finally get “The Professor” to come after 2+ years of trying to convince him. Sure he may have come a half hour late but this is progress. If I’m lucky I may be able to get a full pickup out of him before he leaves the Bay. During this trash pickup I officially signed up for the SF half marathon at the end of July. I haven’t really trained and don’t plan on either except for Midnight runners but it’ll be fine I think. I do expect to get my butt kicked by “La Tacqueria royalty” and “The Dentist” but thats expected. After trash pickup we do the usual post trash pickup hang. We hang out in Dolo where we see a magic show. Not gonna lie the magic show wasn’t that great. The performer made *way* too many jokes that weren’t that great and the actual trick was pretty easy to see if you know what to look for. Essentially he took a card that I signed and gave it back to me. He did a bit of a fakeout where he pretended he lost it and “switched” it but you could see him do a last minute swap. Also the sharpie I used to sign the card may have been in his mouth at first … I made sure to wash my hands after that. From there I hung out more with “The Raja of Rhythm” and “Always causing a racquet”. After that I went home and wrote up the newsletter.
