This was definitely the most involved day of the week so it should get easier from here! Saturday I wake up shortly before the Tornado warning. I look it and I’m quite flummoxed. The Bay Area is not Tornado alley after all and I would expect to see an Earthquake warning before a tornado warning. I’ll admit that after the Tsunami warning and all the flood warnings I was skpetical. That being said I did have a window open and could definitely feel some of the wind. On top of that there was that part of me in the back of my head that was wondering if it was real after all. Instead of doing anything practical I just stare at the clock and wait it out. As  6 o’clock came the wind started to die down and my skepticism increased. Eventually 6:15 rolled around and it looks like no Tornado after all! A few hours later I go to trash pickup. While theres no tornado its still somewhat windy and rainy. Its trash pickups like this that make me wonder if there will ever be a trash pickup where its only me. Thankfully there were a few other people crazy enough to be there with me and we have a good time! Later I go to Santacon. Some of my run club friends made a plan to go and I decided to tag along. I didn’t buy a ticket before hand considering the fact that I don’t drink and thought I could still tag along to bars along with the fact that a ticket was $52. When I walked into the first bar I was immediately struck with a sense of just how cramped this affair would be. I understand that bars aren’t always the best when it comes to space but this took it to a whole new level.  I really had to fight just to move an inch.  While it didn’t start off on the best foot once I was inside hanging out with my friends things went ok. After the first bar we go to another and unfortunately a problem ensues. It turns out that if I don’t have a ticket I needed to pay cover!  And this cover was $30 mind you! Since thats tantamount to highway robbery I decided not to go and instead get dinner and walk around. It was certainly quite the juxtaposition seeing the sober Humza with all the drunken Santa Clauses wandering around. At this point I was thinking more about all the things I wrote that I’m grateful for with y’all in the Friday section above.  Another thing I thought about how was when I was younger I used to look down more on people who drank and partied and realized it was a defense mechanism because I never really understood them and was a bit scared that I didn’t . One goal of mine is to try and understand more perspectives and views. Mind you I’m not saying I need to agree with a whole bunch of views but more that I wish to understand them. I’m not talking politically either I mean more common things you see every day. Seeing people party in cramped bars is one example, another would be pets. Unlike almost everyone I know I don’t really care much for pets. I also don’t really understand the way people go all gaga for cats and dogs, I’ve tried it a few times but it feels incredibly forced to me. It almost makes me wonder if I’m really human or if there is a critical part of the human condition I’m missing out on. After that bit of soul searching and some great Japanese curry courtesy of Nippon curry I meet back up with my friends after they leave the bar and we walk around a bit and get in line at another bar. Unfortunately there too I learn the cover is $10 without a ticket. While more manageable I still don’t wanna pay so I continue walking around. Eventually I find my way back to the bar and it turns out one of my friends needed to leave so I was able to get his ticket! Success! I went into the bar cover free and met back up with my other friends. After this we go to another bar. While waiting in line I see a full on fight break out! It started when I see some woman fall down. I attempt to try and help her up but then I see more people fall down around her and I run out of the way. Afterwards I see a quarrel between two Santas where they are straight up punching each other. I watch from the sidelines until it breaks up. One of the bystanders winds up loosing her phone. I ask if she needs someone to call it but they turn down the offer. One of my friends helps up the woman who fell. I’ll admit I was shaken up by this; while I heard of these things happening at Santa con before seeing it happen made me quite upset. I’m all for having a good time but this is too much and frankly unacceptable behavior. Once that dies down and we wait in line we get into the next bar. Its here unfortunately that I see a huge swarm of people and I begin to feel quite uncomfortable. I wouldn’t say I’m claustrophobic but having to fight so much to move so little really annoyed me. After spending a bit of time here I decided to bid Santacon 2024 fair well. All in all I’d say I give it a C+, a bit above average but ultimately still pretty mid. Just not for me unfortunately. At this point I get home and start typing up the letter! Not much else to say I suppose, thanks for taking the time to read!
